offence_category.reason: Offence is homicide under s.302 IPC, categorised as murder.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted under ss.148, 201, 302 and sentenced; specific sentence not given.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court upheld s.302 conviction and set aside ss.148 and 201 convictions.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court allowed the appeal and set aside conviction and sentence, so accused acquitted.

offence_finally_established.reason: No conviction stands after the Supreme Court's decision.

imprisonment_type.reason: No sentence stands; appellants ordered released, so 'none' fits the schema.

attempt_completion.reason: The victim died, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.reason: Judgment records multiple incised wounds and death from haemorrhage to right lung and liver.

number_of_offences.reason: Four sections charged (147, 323, 324, 302); none finally upheld after Supreme Court decision.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is involved.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Fleeing is only the prosecution case; the Court made no finding on it.

custody_duration.reason: Judgment does not state the custody period.

trial_duration.reason: Offence date 25 May 1999, High Court 4.3.2008, Supreme Court 9 March 2010; trial judgment date not given.
